bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 213 (Wednesday, December 17, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. SCHAKOWSKY:
H.R. 6818.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The Congress shall have Power . . . To regulate Commerce
with foreign Nations, and among the several States, and with
the Indian Tribes.
[Page H6025]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committees on House Administration, Oversight and Government Reform, and the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Part-Time Worker Bill of Rights Act
